key_insight: SURGENT is a multi-agent surgical assistant that combines planning, retrieval, and memory to support reasoning across the full perioperative workflow.
clinical_relevance: It may help clinicians produce more context-aware, auditable recommendations for surgical planning, monitoring, risk assessment, and rehabilitation support.
method: Multi-department collaboration agents plus retrieval from guidelines and biomedical literature
Long-term and short-term memory to preserve patient context across tasks
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on five perioperative tasks, with SURGENT outperforming baseline LLMs and existing medical multi-agent frameworks and improving alignment with patient histories.
watch_item: Performance is reported from abstract-level experimental evaluation, so real-world clinical safety, generalizability, and workflow integration still need prospective validation.
paper_title: SURGENT: A Surgical Multi-Agent Assistance System Across the Perioperative Workflow
